title: LeanCTX Team Signature Envelope v1
description: Detached Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 JCS canonical bytes of one team-context-v1 record. Referenced by authority-decision, policy and team-receipt through signature_envelope_digest, so an approval carries a verifiable signature and its verification key, not a hash of a signature.

alg.description: Only Ed25519 (RFC 8032) is admitted in v1. Algorithm agility is a versioned contract change, never a runtime negotiation.

key_epoch.description: Monotonic rotation epoch of key_id. A verifier rejects an envelope whose epoch is below the tenant's current minimum accepted epoch.

public_key.description: Ed25519 verification key, 32 raw bytes encoded as unpadded base64url (43 characters). Present so an offline verifier needs only the envelope plus the signed record.

signed_payload_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 JCS canonical bytes of the signed record with the record's own signature_envelope_digest field omitted. Omission is required because the record references this envelope, and this envelope references the record.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, 64 raw bytes encoded as unpadded base64url (86 characters), computed over the ASCII bytes of the string 'leanctx-team-context-v1:' concatenated with signed_payload_kind, ':' and signed_payload_digest.

signed_by_digest.description: Privacy-safe signer identity for team-receipt only; it MUST equal the receipt actor_digest.
